rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: same module ID pattern, receiver names, Validate, Caddyfile unmarshalling, interface guards, and reuse of net/http parsing via http.Response.Cookies().
rationale.edge_cases: Unparseable values and unmatched names pass through, quoted values keep quotes, hash uses parsed value, delete drops the entry, exact name match; whitespace around '=' and before ';' is not preserved verbatim.
rationale.scope: Only the new filter plus registration and guards; no unrelated edits or dead code.
rationale.readability: Clear flow and names; the seg/rest if/else with redundant empty assignment could be strings.Cut, and the eq==-1 branch is defensive-only given the parser already rejected such lines.
rationale.robustness: No panics: index bounds guarded, quote check requires len>=2, non-array input returned unchanged, stateless filter.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile and Validate are copied verbatim from CookieFilter instead of shared; Filter relies on Go's parser and a separate manual split agreeing on the leading pair.
